protocol: CBB Originator V2 Phase 1: verified data + annual refit + recency weighting
status: FROZEN before any development fold was fit (committed before `python -m cbb_platform.v2.marginal dev` ran)
question: Does annual refitting with recency weighting improve next-season marginal prediction quality?
fixed: feature definitions and loader SQL (props_v0.load_frames, props_v0_participation.load)
player-rate history half-life 1.0 season (config.recency: a feature definition)
participation model family (L2 logistic, 23 inputs, L2_ALPHA)
minutes model family (weighted ridge, ridge_alpha, clip, residual-SD bands)
per-minute rate family (position prior + shrinkage k by method of moments on unweighted player-season finals)
distribution families and the NB/Poisson dispersion rule
STL Negative Binomial phi = 0.16 (final_prelockbox_spec.json accepted change)

changed.A_training_cutoff: ANNUAL_REFIT = through F-1; ONE_SEASON_STALE = through F-2 (forecast season F)
changed.B_training_row_weight: w(s) = 2 ** (-(S - s) / h), S = last training season of the fit

normalization: weights divided by their mean over the rows of each fit (sum(w) = n), so the ridge penalty ridge_alpha * sum(w) and the participation penalty L2_ALPHA * n are identical across policies; every other weighted quantity in v1 is scale-invariant
where_weights_apply: exactly where v1 applies training-row weights (props_v0.fit `_w`: minutes standardization + ridge, minutes residual SD bands, position prior rates, NB dispersion, rolling-baseline population means) and to the participation log-likelihood (weighted IRLS). Not applied to the player-rate history feature or to the shrinkage-k method of moments (both unweighted by season in v1 / fixed definitions).

reference_not_selectable.V1REF: v1 training weights verbatim: 0.5 ** (age / 1.0), unnormalized (props_v0.fit); participation unweighted. Reported because v1 already weights training rows by season (h = 1); it cannot be selected

data.equivalence: modeling/player_props_v2/data_provenance.json: identical to the dev store for <= 2024-25 up to float summation noise (max rel 9.4e-16)
data.same_features_rule: within a forecast season every candidate scores the identical rows (row_identity_sha256) with identical point-in-time features; only fitted state differs
data.unit: whole games (rows of one forecast season); no random splitting; chronological only

folds.stat_training_rows: every scored row of seasons 2013-14 .. train_through
folds.participation_training_rows: identifiable rows of seasons 2023-24 .. train_through (no DNP labels exist earlier): F2024 both arms and F2025 stale are NOT ESTIMABLE; F2025 annual trains on 2023-24 only (all policies identical after normalization)

metrics.counts: PTS REB AST FG3M STL BLK TOV: log score, discrete CRPS, central coverage 50/80/95, mean bias, mean-bucket calibration, threshold Brier / log loss / gap at the predeclared lockbox scorecard lines (lockbox_runner.HALF_LINES: PTS 5.5/9.5/14.5, REB 2.5/4.5/6.5, others 0.5/1.5/2.5)
metrics.aggregate: n-weighted mean over the 7 count targets of per-row log score / CRPS (lockbox G1 definition)
metrics.minutes: MAE, RMSE, bias, coverage, log score, CRPS of the discretized normal
metrics.participation: Brier, log loss, calibration slope, calibration-in-the-large, AUC (descriptive), buckets
metrics.uncertainty: game-clustered CR1 95 % interval of paired per-row differences (lockbox_runner.cr1_interval)
metrics.subgroups_diagnostic_only: stat x role (role_l5_minutes_rank: TOP5_MINUTES <= 5, ROTATION_6_8, BENCH_9PLUS, NO_ROLE_HISTORY) and stat x position group (G/F/C/U from the pregame last box position, the model's own input)

selection.data: development folds F2024 + F2025 only, ANNUAL_REFIT arm (the policy as it would be deployed), pooled row-weighted
hierarchy: 3 stability: count of (fold x target) log-score wins
6 calibration: mean |threshold gap| over targets and lines
selection.clear_rule_steps_1_2_5: best = lowest pooled value; another policy is eliminated only if its pooled difference to the best has a game-clustered 95 % interval entirely above 0 AND is positive in each development fold; otherwise it stays tied and the next step decides among the tied set
selection.point_rule_steps_3_4_6: strict best value among the tied set; exact ties remain tied
selection.final_tie_break: largest effective sample size: W0, then W4, then W2
selection.no_other_half_lives: no further half-life is tested in this phase without architect approval
selection.recorded_before_2025_26: modeling/player_props_v2/weighting_selection.json is committed before the confirmation stage runs; the confirmation stage refuses to run unless that file is committed unchanged

annual_refit_support.per_season: selected policy: ANNUAL_REFIT minus ONE_SEASON_STALE on aggregate log score and aggregate CRPS (negative = annual better), with clustered intervals
annual_refit_support.ANNUAL_REFIT_POLICY_SUPPORTED: TRUE if annual is better on both aggregate log score and CRPS in F2024, F2025 and F2026; FALSE if annual is worse on both in at least two of the three seasons; MIXED otherwise

confirmation_2025_26.runs: exactly once (refuses if its record exists)
confirmation_2025_26.references: V1REF stale and annual (V1REF annual through 2024-25 = the v1 champion specification refit on the common store)
confirmation_2025_26.nature: retrospective confirmation; not a lockbox; not a tuning set; the selected policy is not changed by its result

final_refit.after: provenance PASS, selection recorded, confirmation recorded
final_refit.role: V2 CHALLENGER; never auto-promoted; the v1 champion artifact stays unchanged

oos_forecast_store.source: saved ANNUAL_REFIT states of the selected policy (trained only on earlier seasons); no fit at store time
oos_forecast_store.population: every pregame player candidate of each forecast season
oos_forecast_store.in_sample_residuals: never (the final through-2025-26 model is not used)

resources: one heavy job at a time; per-candidate states (small JSON) kept; no multi-GB candidate stores
